usage.outputShape: body.translated_text (the translation); also body.source_language, body.target_language, body.formality, body.confidence, body.model; body._meta.call_id for audit
usage.guide: Send a POST to https://bazaar-gateway.vercel.app/api/translate with a JSON body containing two required fields: text (the string to translate) and target_language (a plain language name like "french", "spanish", "arabic", "japanese"). Payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.005 per call, no API key needed. The response is synchronous JSON; read the translation from body.translated_text. Source language is auto-detected and returned in body.source_language.
